rule: DRUG_STOCK_FIXTURE_PATH is the source when it is set, and that path performs no Google call. A fixture is a JSON array of long rows, or an object with values for a wide Form sheet plus optional timeZone and protocol_drugs. Deploy uses DRUG_STOCK_SHEET_ID and DRUG_STOCK_GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS together. DRUG_STOCK_SHEET_RANGE defaults to A:ZZ. Live reads use UNFORMATTED_VALUE and SERIAL_NUMBER. Naive Timestamps are wall time in the spreadsheet timeZone (UTC when the spreadsheet does not say). Wide rows add submitter_email and sheet_row. 0.6.6_to_0.6.7 stores submitted_by (submitter_email is an alias) and sheet_row; pull.py SUBMITTER_FIELD is the one-line switch to the canonical key. Earlier drug_stock_pull_apply ignores unknown keys. If neither source is set, the process exits non-zero and writes nothing. Do not commit values for these variables.
